headline: SK Hynix Shares Rally on High AI Memory Chip Demand
summary: Shares of SK Hynix advanced as strong global demand for high-bandwidth memory chips used in artificial intelligence hardware drove investor buying.
why: SK Hynix is one of South Korea's largest technology companies and a vital global manufacturer of advanced memory chips.

impacts.name: SK Hynix Inc.
impacts.why: Strong market demand for high-bandwidth artificial intelligence memory chips boosted revenue expectations.

why_moved: Continued strong demand for advanced AI memory hardware drove investor enthusiasm and buy orders for SK Hynix stock.
